findings.source_quote: Hymns of the Heart; The Passion of Jesus; The Song of the Seraphs; Rise, Glorious Conqueror; Hymns and Sacred Lyrics; Hymns of the Church; Diademata
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the English substantive titles into standard contemporary German (while retaining original italics and HTML structure). Examples: "Hymns of the Heart" → "Hymnen des Herzens" (or a literal German rendering used by the publisher, if established); "The Passion of Jesus" → "Die Passion Jesu"; "The Song of the Seraphs" → "Das Lied der Seraphim"; "Rise, Glorious Conqueror" → "Erhebe dich, ruhmreicher Sieger" (or a commonly used German title if one exists); "Hymns and Sacred Lyrics" → "Hymnen und geistliche Lyrik"; "Hymns of the Church" → "Hymnen der Kirche". Preserve italics and tags exactly as in source HTML (for example: Die Passion Jesu in place of The Passion of Jesus). For the tune name Diademata you may keep the original word (proper name) but add a short parenthetical German gloss if desired (e.g. Diademata (‚diademata‘ = „königliche Krone“)).
findings.translation_quote: All occurrences of the italicized English titles remain untranslated in the German article (e.g. "Hymns of the Heart", "The Passion of Jesus", "Rise, Glorious Conqueror", "Hymns and Sacred Lyrics", "Hymns of the Church", and tune name "Diademata").

findings.location: Paragraph: "So like we… mid–1800s" (source paragraph beginning "As sadly, we find many factions…")
findings.source_quote: As sadly, we find many factions in the Christian church today, so also was the scope of things going on in the mid–1800s.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the German idiom and numeric expression. Replace "Mitte des 1800. Jahrhunderts" with a standard German formulation such as "Mitte des 19. Jahrhunderts" or "Mitte der 1800er Jahre". Preserve surrounding HTML tags and sentence structure.
findings.translation_quote: "So wie wir heute leider viele Fraktionen in der christlichen Kirche finden, so war auch das Spannungsfeld Mitte des 1800. Jahrhunderts vielfältig."

findings.source_quote: Hark! how the heavenly anthems drowns all music but its own;
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more idiomatic German verb for 'drowns' in musical sense. For example: "Hört! wie die himmlischen Gesänge alle andere Musik übertönen, außer ihrer eigenen;" Keep the HTML and line breaks unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: "Hört! wie die himmlischen Anthemen jede Musik verschlingen, außer ihrer eigenen;"
